g.data-semantic-relation: use phrase tokens to guide image queries into boxes
g.data-must-show: phrase token 的箭頭導向 query selection/cross-modal decoder | 輸出 phrase-conditioned boxes/scores | Grounding DINO 以 phrase 導引 object queries
g.data-not-claim: 同一 image 換 phrase 可產生不同候選，分數不可視為固定 defect probability。
g.title: phrase 導引 queries 成框
